cover: Prompt injection, explained for business owners

slides.title: Text the AI reads can give it orders
slides.body: Your instructions and the content the AI reads arrive as one stream. The model can't reliably tell which part is which.

slides.title: The dangerous kind is hidden
slides.body: Instructions tucked into an email, a PDF or a web page the AI reads for someone. The person using the tool never sees them.

slides.title: Actions raise the stakes
slides.body: A chatbot can be made to say something wrong. An agent that can edit records or send email can be made to do something wrong.

slides.title: Give it the least access that works
slides.body: An assistant that drafts replies doesn't need to send them. Every permission left out is one an attacker can't use.

slides.title: Keep a person on expensive actions
slides.body: Refunds, deletions, payments and customer messages wait for approval. The AI prepares them and a person confirms.

slides.title: Enforce permissions outside the model
slides.body: If the AI never receives the confidential file, no hidden instruction can make it leak that file.
